samples.marker: NanoCore RAT: separate API references from family and staging claims
evidence: CLR entry method 462 runs ClientLoaderForm; Shown callback 464 hides the form and invokes initialization method 94.
Initialization method 95 wires received packets to method 170. Method 301 decrypts/deserializes the packet and method 170 dispatches base, plugin, and file commands.

File-command dispatcher 214 reaches methods 225/226 and file stream read/write methods 70/71. Plugin commands 26/30 reach 302, which loads plugin bytes via 350/Assembly.Load and instantiates plugin constructors.

Eazfuscator-style opaque identifiers, constant conditional branches and resource-backed encrypted strings obscure the code. The resource reader is in string-decoding method 255; API co-occurrence does not establish a separate resource stage loader.

samples.identification: Patched XMRig self-replicator with embedded Cobalt Strike Beacon
samples.marker: XMRig replicator/Beacon: detect footer-counter self-replica launches
evidence: CRT entry 0x14009a1bc invokes main 0x14002add4. Main opens argv[0], reads its image, reads the last two dwords, decrements one and loops while the other remains positive.

Main generates random executable paths under C:\Windows\System, copies its own bytes, appends random data and both footer fields, closes each output and calls CreateProcessW on it before starting the normal XMRig application. The input footer dwords are 1765093170 and 171785575. Failure to open protected output paths can prevent replication or crash; no execution was performed.

The independently carved PE at 0x5b8601 is a reflective Beacon DLL. Function 0x10009619 XORs its 4096-byte settings block at raw offset 0x2f228 with 0x69, parses typed fields, and clears the encoded block.

Decoded configuration specifies port 443, 5000ms sleep, ns7/ns8/ns9.softline.top, Amazon-like HTTP paths and Host header, GET/POST methods, rundll32 spawn targets and an msagent named-pipe format. Detection does not require those chosen endpoint names.

Beacon function 0x10007e88 builds a hidden PowerShell EncodedCommand from command bytes, redirects its output to pipes, launches it and registers output handling. ReflectiveLoader maps PE sections, resolves imports and transfers control.

The large independently carved helper PE at 0xfc400 has no hostile or suspicious findings before or after edits. Neither its presence nor the collector filename supplies a verdict. No outer-to-Beacon launch relationship is asserted.

samples.marker: Entra provisioning: credential references do not establish persistence
evidence: The complete top-level program constructs HttpClient with a bearer token from GRAPH_TOKEN, posts a Global Administrator role assignment for ACTOR_PRINCIPAL_ID and checks success.
For each explicitly supplied TARGET_APPLICATION_IDS entry it posts addPassword with a display name and expiration, checks success, and prints the response locally.

No external exfiltration destination, credential theft, concealment, token acquisition bypass or unauthorized action is established. The sensitive role-grant finding remains suspicious. The paired endpoint-reference observation is neutral and is not filed as login/OAuth persistence.
